title: 第1章 托付废灵体第2章 废灵体也可成神
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
牛棚。
一盆冷水泼来。
十二岁的苏凡一下坐起来，怒视着站在面前的死肥婆。
“瞪什么瞪？太阳都出来了还睡，快滚去后山砍柴！”
死肥婆叉着腰，满脸横肉的大骂。
“还没吃饭呢！”
苏凡委屈巴巴的说道。
“吃吃吃就知道吃。”
死肥婆端起旁边的狗盆，装着发臭的残羹剩饭，扔到苏凡面前，吼道：“拿去吃！”
苏凡捡起旁边的砍柴刀，强忍着怒火，朝后山跑去。
他是孤儿。
被好心的爷爷捡回来抚养，爷爷膝下无子，如待亲孙儿一样疼爱他。
但半年前，年迈的爷爷去世，临终前，把他托付给村长夫妇。
贪财的村长夫妇，得到爷爷的房子和财物，翻脸无情，让他当苦力，睡牛棚，吃狗食，动不动拳打脚踢。
“狗东西，小爷早晚弄死你们。”
苏凡叼着狗尾巴草，骂骂咧咧，从脖子下的衣服里掏出一个吊坠。
这是一个小鼎，仅拇指大，锈迹斑斑，就如一块铁疙瘩。
爷爷临终前交给他的，有什么用没说，只说让他好好保管。
这半年，他一直在观察，啥也没发现。
“小友……”

突然。
身后传来一道虚弱的声音。
一位浑身是血的黑袍道人，踉踉跄跄的朝这边跑来，但没跑几步，便一头栽倒在地。
苏凡拿着砍柴刀，小心翼翼的走过去。
用砍柴刀用力戳了下，见其身体在微微颤抖，便把黑袍道人翻过来，看到那胸膛上的伤口，苏凡倒抽一口凉气。
几条剑伤深可见骨，鲜血止不住的往外冒。
“小友，我怀里有个袋子，请你无论如何，帮我转交给流云宗第十峰长老许三阴，到时他会无条件满足你一个要求。”
“记住，除了他，任何人都不能给……”
说完这句话，黑袍道人脑袋一歪，一命呜呼。
“仙门，流云宗！”
苏凡吃惊。
眼前这人，居然是流云宗的仙人！
从黑袍道人的怀里，果然找到一个黑色袋子，但想尽办法，他也打不开。
无奈只能放弃，将袋子塞进怀里，挖了个坑，埋了黑袍道人。
“那死肥婆好像说过，三天后流云宗会来村里招收弟子，到时我是不是可以要求这个许三阴，带我去流云宗？”
“哈哈……”
“那以后小爷不就是仙人？”
“成了仙人，不就能弄死那两个狗东西？”
content_en:
Bullpen.
A basin of cold water poured over.
Twelve-year-old Su Fan sat up immediately and glared at the fat woman standing in front of him.
"Why are you staring? The sun has come out and you are still sleeping. Go and chop wood in the back mountain!"
The fat woman put her hands on her hips and cursed with all her might.
"You haven't eaten yet!"
Su Fan said aggrievedly.
“Eat, eat, eat and you’ll know how to eat.”
The fat woman picked up the dog bowl next to her, filled it with stinky leftovers, threw it in front of Su Fan, and shouted, "Take it and eat it!"
Su Fan picked up the woodcutter next to him, held back his anger, and ran towards the back mountain.
He is an orphan.
He was picked up and raised by his kind-hearted grandfather, who had no children and loved him as much as his own grandson.
But six months ago, the elderly grandfather passed away. Before his death, he was entrusted to the village chief and his wife.
The money-grubbing village chief and his wife got their grandfather's house and belongings, and they turned against him and made him work as a coolie, sleeping in a cowshed, eating dog food, and punching and kicking him at every turn.
"You bitches, I will kill you sooner or later."
Su Fan held the dog's tail grass in his mouth, cursed, and took out a pendant from the clothes under his neck.
This is a small tripod, only as big as a thumb, and is as rusty as a lump of iron.
Grandpa gave it to him before he died. He didn't say what it was for, he just told him to keep it well.
He has been observing for the past six months and found nothing.
"Little friend..."
suddenly.
A weak voice came from behind.
A black-robed Taoist covered in blood staggered towards this side, but after running a few steps, he fell to the ground.
Su Fan took the woodcutter and walked over cautiously.
He stabbed it hard with a woodcutter and saw that his body was shaking slightly. He turned the black-robed Taoist over and saw the wound on his chest. Su Fan gasped.
Several sword wounds were so deep that the bones could be seen, and blood could not stop pouring out.
"Little friend, I have a bag in my arms. Please help me deliver it to Xu Sanyin, the tenth peak elder of Liuyun Sect, no matter what, and he will unconditionally satisfy your request."
"Remember, no one can give it to anyone but him..."
After saying this, the black-robed Taoist tilted his head and died.
"Xianmen, Liuyun Sect!"
Su Fan was surprised.
The person in front of me is actually an immortal from Liuyun Sect!
Sure enough, he found a black bag from the black-robed Taoist's arms, but he couldn't open it despite trying his best.
He had no choice but to give up, stuffed the bag into his arms, dug a hole, and buried the black-robed Taoist.
"That damn fat woman seems to have said that Liuyun Sect will come to the village to recruit disciples in three days. Can I ask Xu Sanyin to take me to Liuyun Sect then?"
"Haha..."
"Then won't I be an immortal from now on?"
"If you become an immortal, won't you be able to kill those two bitches?"
